# BuildRequest

A project's files, sent to be validated or deployed into a namespace. The SDKs and the `mt` CLI build this from a project folder for you.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isDeploy` | `boolean` | yes | True to deploy the definitions if the build succeeds; false only to validate them. Deploying needs a tenant admin (otherwise 403 `api:builds:deploy-requires-admin`); any member can validate. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `agents` | [`BuildRequestItem`](build-request-item.md)`[]` | yes | Agent files (`agents/`). Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `capsules` | [`BuildRequestItem`](build-request-item.md)`[]` | yes | Capsule files (`capsules/`). Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `connectors` | [`BuildOpenApiAndMcpRequest`](build-open-api-and-mcp-request.md) | yes | Connector files (`connectors/`). Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `externalOperations` | [`BuildOpenApiAndMcpRequest`](build-open-api-and-mcp-request.md) | yes | Tool files (`external-operations/`). Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `interactions` | [`BuildInteractionsRequest`](build-interactions-request.md) | yes | Interaction files (`interactions/`). Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `apps` | [`BuildRequestApp`](build-request-app.md)`[]` | yes | Apps (`apps/`), one entry per app folder. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `codePipelines` | [`BuildRequestCodePipeline`](build-request-code-pipeline.md)`[]` | yes | Code pipeline definitions (`code-pipelines/`), sent as JSON. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `codePipelineHooks` | `map<string,`[`BuildRequestApp`](build-request-app.md)`> \| null` |  | Optional Cogniscript hooks for code pipelines (`code-pipeline-hooks/`), keyed by the pipeline's name. |
| `looms` | [`BuildRequestItem`](build-request-item.md)`[] \| null` |  | Optional named looms (`looms/<name>.mtr`). |
| `resourceFiles` | [`ResourceFileReferences`](resource-file-references.md) | yes | The shared prompts and JSON files the other files read with `@prompt` and `@json`. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
